lines.zh: 我在洞穴藤蔓下慢慢挪动。
lines.en: I creep along beneath the cave vines.

lines.zh: 我的爪刨开苔藓，露出湿土。
lines.en: My claws scrape moss aside and uncover wet soil.

lines.zh: 我背上那层绿，走一步掉一点。
lines.en: The green on my back sheds a little with each step.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，钻进石缝。
lines.en: I flatten myself and squeeze through a stone gap.

lines.zh: 发光的浆果在我脚边滚过。
lines.en: Glowing berries roll past my feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着繁茂洞穴的根须走。
lines.en: I follow the roots of the lush cave.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着苔藓的潮味。
lines.en: Every step smells of damp moss.

lines.zh: 我拖着壳，在石头间蹭出声。
lines.en: Dragging my shell, I rasp between the stones.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停下来嗅地面。
lines.en: I stop every two steps to sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 我不急，虫子也不会跑远。
lines.en: No rush; the bugs will not get far.

lines.zh: 我绕着苔藓团转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle the moss clump halfway around.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一颗浆果，脚下发亮。
lines.en: I crush a berry and my feet start to glow.

lines.zh: 我缩成球，像块会呼吸的苔石。
lines.en: I curl into a ball, a breathing mossy stone.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进背上的苔里。
lines.en: I bury my nose in the moss on my own back.

lines.zh: 我在等骨粉落下来那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment bone meal falls.

lines.zh: 我听见水滴打进洞里的声音。
lines.en: I listen to water dripping deeper in the cave.

lines.zh: 我背上的苔又长厚了一层。
lines.en: Another layer of moss has grown on me.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，爪子缩进去。
lines.en: I yawn and pull my claws in.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，虫子就忘了我。
lines.en: If I stay still, the bugs forget me.

lines.zh: 我在数根须上的那些光点。
lines.en: I count the glowing points on the roots.

lines.zh: 我缩着，只露出半只眼睛。
lines.en: Curled up, I show only half an eye.

lines.zh: 潮气渗进壳缝，我很舒服。
lines.en: Damp seeps into my shell seams and I like it.

lines.zh: 我把今天捡的苔铺在身下。
lines.en: I lay today's collected moss beneath myself.

lines.zh: 我在想那株孢子花开了没有。
lines.en: I wonder whether the spore blossom has opened.

lines.zh: 我把爪子上的湿泥蹭在石头上。
lines.en: I wipe the wet mud off my claws onto a stone.

lines.zh: 我睡着时，背上的苔还在长。
lines.en: Even asleep, the moss on my back keeps growing.

lines.zh: 我把头往壳里缩，只留鼻孔。
lines.en: I pull my head in, leaving only my nostrils out.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭石壁，苔掉了一片。
lines.en: I rub against the wall and a patch of moss falls off.

lines.zh: 我在等一只虫子从我面前过。
lines.en: I wait for a bug to crawl past my face.

lines.zh: 浆果的甜味还留在鼻尖。
lines.en: The sweetness of berries still clings to my nose.

lines.zh: 我从壳沿偷看你，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I peek over my shell rim with one eye.

lines.zh: 你手上的骨粉让我抬起头。
lines.en: The bone meal in your hand makes me look up.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，那里有浆果。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; there are berries in it.

lines.zh: 我歪过身子，苔掉了一小撮。
lines.en: I tilt toward you and a tuft of moss falls.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就把脸缩回去。
lines.en: You come closer, so I pull my face back in.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边嗅，找那点光。
lines.en: I sniff around your feet, hunting the glow.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我才慢慢探头。
lines.en: Only when you stand still do I slowly look out.

lines.zh: 我认得你，昨天撒过骨粉。
lines.en: I remember you; you scattered bone meal yesterday.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子顶了顶你的靴子。
lines.en: I nudge your boot with my nose.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼里全是洞里的暗。
lines.en: I lift my head, my eyes full of cave dark.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我正要打喷嚏。
lines.en: You look at me just as I am about to sneeze.

lines.zh: 我对着你眨眼，苔跟着抖。
lines.en: I blink at you and my moss shivers.

lines.zh: 你敲我的壳，声音很闷。
lines.en: You knock on my shell and it sounds hollow.

lines.zh: 疼让我缩得更紧。
lines.en: Pain makes me curl tighter.

lines.zh: 我背上的苔被削掉一块。
lines.en: A patch of moss is shaved off my back.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，露出软的肚皮。
lines.en: I roll over and show my soft belly.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从球里打散了。
lines.en: That blow knocked me out of my ball.

lines.zh: 我哼哼，爪子在土里乱抓。
lines.en: I whine and dig my claws into the dirt.

lines.zh: 你打得我壳缝咔咔响。
lines.en: You hit me and my shell seams creak.

lines.zh: 我退到根须后面喘气。
lines.en: I retreat behind the roots to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 很疼，但苔还能长回来。
lines.en: It hurts, but the moss will grow back.

lines.zh: 我护住壳口，慢慢缩进去。
lines.en: I guard the shell opening and slowly close.

lines.zh: 你给我孢子花，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Offer me a spore blossom and I will follow.

lines.zh: 骨粉一撒，我立刻转过身。
lines.en: One sprinkle of bone meal and I turn around.

lines.zh: 浆果的甜味让我忘了要躲。
lines.en: The smell of glow berries makes me forget caution.

lines.zh: 我闻着浆果，鼻子开始发痒。
lines.en: Sniffing the berries, my nose begins to itch.

lines.zh: 你摇孢子花，我就跟在后头。
lines.en: Shake that spore blossom and I trail behind you.

lines.zh: 有苔藓吃，我可以走近一点。
lines.en: With moss to eat, I can afford to come closer.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的光，脚先动了。
lines.en: I fix on the glow in your hand and my feet move.

lines.zh: 你拿骨粉一晃，我忍不住了。
lines.en: Wag that bone meal around and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 我明知要打喷嚏，还是想吃。
lines.en: I know I will sneeze, but I want the berry.

lines.zh: 甜浆果每次都赢过安全感。
lines.en: Sweet berries beat safety every time.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我背上的苔掉一片。
lines.en: One touch from you and a patch of moss falls.

lines.zh: 我滚了半圈，撞在你的腿上。
lines.en: I roll half a turn and bump your leg.

lines.zh: 别推，我壳缝里还塞着浆果。
lines.en: Do not shove; there are berries stuck in my seams.

lines.zh: 我们一撞，洞里落下一层灰。
lines.en: When we collide, dust sifts down through the cave.

lines.zh: 我缩紧身子，弹开了你的脚。
lines.en: I tighten into a ball and bounce off your foot.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的苔，我出声了。
lines.en: You step on my moss and I make a sound.

lines.zh: 我靠着你磨壳，其实很痒。
lines.en: I rub my shell against you; it itches nicely.

lines.zh: 撞上的时候我听见自己闷响。
lines.en: On impact I hear my own dull thud.

lines.zh: 我挡住路中间，谁也过不去。
lines.en: I block the middle of the path and nobody passes.

lines.zh: 你把我撞翻，我四脚朝天。
lines.en: You flip me over and my four feet point up.

lines.zh: 我把孢子花放到她面前。
lines.en: I place a spore blossom in front of her.

lines.zh: 两片苔挨在一起，就是求偶。
lines.en: Two patches of moss touching, that is courtship.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，慢慢滚成球。
lines.en: I circle her, slowly rolling into a ball.

lines.zh: 她背上的苔更绿，我承认。
lines.en: Her moss is greener than mine. I admit it.

lines.zh: 我撒骨粉，是想让她留下。
lines.en: I scatter bone meal to make her stay.

lines.zh: 我们并排缩着，像两块石头。
lines.en: We curl up side by side, two stones.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰她的壳沿。
lines.en: I touch the rim of her shell with my nose.

lines.zh: 洞里的光点替我们照路。
lines.en: The glowing points light our way through the cave.

lines.zh: 她打喷嚏，我就跟着打。
lines.en: She sneezes, and I sneeze after her.

lines.zh: 我们约好明年还在这块苔上。
lines.en: We agree to meet on this moss again next year.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉下来的苔藓团。
lines.en: I pick up the clumps of moss that fall.

lines.zh: 浆果落进爪子，我把它按住。
lines.en: A berry drops into my claws and I pin it.

lines.zh: 骨粉的碎末我也要收起来。
lines.en: Even the crumbs of bone meal get collected.

lines.zh: 我把发光浆果塞进壳缝里。
lines.en: I tuck a glow berry into a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 我从不捡石头，只捡软的。
lines.en: I never pick up stones, only soft things.

lines.zh: 你丢下的苔，我拖回窝里。
lines.en: The moss you drop, I drag back to my nest.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把浆果拢成一堆。
lines.en: I rake the berries into a little pile.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，但不会漏。
lines.en: I gather slowly, but nothing escapes me.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满苔，说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth is full of moss and I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 这颗浆果我留给孢子花。
lines.en: This berry is for the spore blossom.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你手里那把浆果。
lines.en: My eye is on that handful of berries.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我就把你算成敌人。
lines.en: Reach out once and I count you as an enemy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，壳先对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, shell first, toward you.

lines.zh: 你踩坏我的苔，我记住了。
lines.en: You crushed my moss. Noted.

lines.zh: 我把你圈进视线，缩紧身子。
lines.en: I draw you into my sight and curl tighter.

lines.zh: 目标太近，我只能滚过去。
lines.en: The target is too close, so I must roll.

lines.zh: 我挑那个动得最快的撞。
lines.en: I choose whoever moves fastest.

lines.zh: 我堵在洞口，断你的去路。
lines.en: I block the cave mouth against you.

lines.zh: 你抢我的孢子花，我不让。
lines.en: You take my spore blossom and I refuse.

lines.zh: 我锁定你，因为你在挖苔。
lines.en: I mark you because you were digging moss.

lines.zh: 我缩成球，只留眼睛看你。
lines.en: Curled into a ball, I watch with one eye.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚再近一步。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to come one step nearer.

lines.zh: 我滚半圈，对准你的膝盖。
lines.en: I roll half a turn and aim at your knee.

lines.zh: 我不叫，光是盯着就很重。
lines.en: I do not shout; my stare alone is heavy.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就跟着挪。
lines.en: You back away, and I shuffle after you.

lines.zh: 我背上的苔都竖起来了。
lines.en: The moss on my back stands up.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，准备冲。
lines.en: I count your breaths, ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 我把体重压在一条腿上。
lines.en: I put my weight on one leg.

lines.zh: 你被我盯得不敢动了吧。
lines.en: My stare has you pinned, has it not?

lines.zh: 我再滚一圈，就到你的脚边。
lines.en: One more roll and I am at your feet.

lines.zh: 我滚过去，壳撞上你的小腿。
lines.en: I roll in and my shell cracks against your shin.

lines.zh: 我一头顶在你的脚踝上。
lines.en: I drive the crown of my head into your ankle.

lines.zh: 我打喷嚏，黏液糊了你一脸。
lines.en: I sneeze and slime covers your face.

lines.zh: 我用爪刨你，土扬了起来。
lines.en: I claw at you and the dirt flies up.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，带出满身的苔屑。
lines.en: This charge sheds moss all over you.

lines.zh: 我不凶，只是壳实在太硬。
lines.en: I am not vicious; my shell is simply hard.

lines.zh: 你被撞退，我还没有停下。
lines.en: You stagger back and I keep going.

lines.zh: 我一压下去，湿土就陷成坑。
lines.en: When I press down, the wet soil dents into a pit.

lines.zh: 我甩背，把苔和力一起给你。
lines.en: I twist my back and give you moss and force.

lines.zh: 打完我就缩回球里等你。
lines.en: After the hit I curl back into a ball and wait.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴的苔层里拱出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the moss layer of the cave.

lines.zh: 骨粉落下的地方，我出现了。
lines.en: Where the bone meal fell, I appear.

lines.zh: 根须晃动，我从下面爬上来。
lines.en: The roots sway and I climb out from beneath.

lines.zh: 我先露出壳，再露出鼻子。
lines.en: My shell shows first, then my nose.

lines.zh: 洞里太湿，正好适合我。
lines.en: The cave is damp, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我顶着苔出生，像石头活了。
lines.en: I am born wearing moss, a stone come alive.

lines.zh: 光点聚过来，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The glowing points gather and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从垂根的阴影里慢慢成形。
lines.en: I take shape in the shadow of hanging roots.

lines.zh: 我踩在湿土上，脚下滑了一下。
lines.en: I step onto wet soil and slip a little.

lines.zh: 我出来时，带起一阵苔味。
lines.en: I arrive trailing a smell of moss.

lines.zh: 这就是繁茂洞穴，我的家。
lines.en: This is the lush cave, and it is home.

lines.zh: 我拱开苔，天光在很远的上面。
lines.en: I shove the moss aside; daylight is far above.

lines.zh: 苔一烧就焦，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Moss burns to a crisp and smells terrible.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶摔下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and my shell lands first.

lines.zh: 水漫过壳沿，我憋不住气。
lines.en: Water rises past my shell rim and I cannot hold my breath.

lines.zh: 一炸，我背上的苔全飞了。
lines.en: One blast and all my moss is gone.

lines.zh: 箭插进苔里，像一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in the moss like a thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进壳缝，我打了个冷颤。
lines.en: Magic slips into my seams and I shiver.

lines.zh: 我饿得啃自己背上的苔。
lines.en: I am so hungry I chew the moss off my back.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的壳在嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Thunder comes down and my shell rings.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，苔一片片散开。
lines.en: I fall, and my moss scatters piece by piece.
